pass_rule: Every binding equals current pointers; current manifest_fingerprint is non-empty; CONTENT LOCK stores the exact manifest_fingerprint; cited evidence is current/non-STALE; R10/R11/R12 same manifest; R13 exact copy+manifest+scope.
immutable_rule: Once LOCKED, any bound artifact/evidence change requires new CONTENT LOCK version with supersedes; never mutate old lock.
post_lock_publish_rule: CONTENT LOCK is not permanent publish authorization. R14 publish package must bind CONTENT LOCK path/id + final_copy fingerprint + exact manifest_fingerprint, then PUBLISH_COMPLIANCE_GATE must issue a time-bounded authorization before PUBLISH_READY.
content_count_rule: CONTENT LOCK creation or re-lock never increments R16 periodic count. Count is created only after R01 confirms actual PASS/PUBLISHED.
